project: RLQAS Phase 2 - Task 001: Multi-RL Algorithm Support (DQN Implementation)
description: Extend RLQAS system to support DQN algorithm in addition to existing PPO, establishing baseline for multi-algorithm comparison. This task builds upon Phase 1 integration (Phase1/006) and focuses on implementing DQN while maintaining compatibility with existing interfaces.

phaseDependencies.prerequisite: Phase 1 must be fully integrated and validated before starting Phase 2

objectives.description: Implement DQNAgent class conforming to RLAgent abstract interface from Phase 1
acceptance_criteria: DQNAgent implements all abstract methods from RLAgent base class
Agent follows Stable-Baselines3 DQN implementation patterns
Supports both discrete action spaces required for quantum architecture search
Provides reasonable default hyperparameters optimized for RLQAS tasks
Passes all interface compatibility tests with existing RLQAS components

objectives.description: Extend AgentFactory to support creation of both PPO and DQN agents
acceptance_criteria: AgentFactory can instantiate both PPOAgent and DQNAgent via unified interface
Factory supports configuration-based agent selection
Maintains backward compatibility with Phase 1 PPO-only usage
Provides type hints and clear error messages for unsupported agent types
Supports dynamic agent switching in test environments

objectives.description: Ensure DQN agent integrates seamlessly with Phase 1 components
acceptance_criteria: DQN agent works with UCCSearchEnv environment from Phase 1
Compatible with molecule processing pipeline and quantum simulator
Supports UCC state formatting and action parsing methods
Maintains compatibility with validation and testing infrastructure
No breaking changes to Phase 1 public APIs

objectives.description: Define and validate default hyperparameters for DQN in RLQAS context
acceptance_criteria: Provide optimized default hyperparameters for quantum architecture search
Hyperparameters produce stable learning on simple test environments
Configuration system supports easy tuning and experimentation
Document hyperparameter effects and recommendations
Include example configurations for different molecular systems
Unit tests verify DQNAgent interface compliance (>90% coverage)
Integration tests validate DQN works with Phase 1 environment
Learning tests confirm DQN can solve simple RL problems
Comparison tests verify DQN vs PPO performance differences
All tests pass with >90% code coverage requirement

objectives.description: Implement checkpoint saving and loading for DQN agents
acceptance_criteria: DQNAgent.save() creates complete checkpoint files
DQNAgent.load() restores agent state correctly
Checkpoint format is compatible with Phase 1 conventions
Supports resume training from saved checkpoints
Includes model parameters, optimizer state, and replay buffer

implementationRequirements.actionSpace: Discrete (required for quantum excitation operator selection)
implementationRequirements.stateRepresentation: Compatible with Phase 1 UCC state formatting
implementationRequirements.checkpointFormat: Consistent with PPO agent checkpoint structure

compatibilityRequirements: Must build upon Phase 1 integrated package (Phase1/006)
No breaking changes to existing Phase 1 APIs
Must maintain compatibility with UCCSearchEnv and molecule processing
Checkpoint files should follow Phase 1 naming conventions
implementationConstraints: Use Stable-Baselines3 for DQN implementation (consistent with Phase 1 PPO choice)
Follow Phase 1 code organization patterns and naming conventions
Maintain >90% test coverage for new code
Include comprehensive documentation and type hints

integrationPoints.withPhase1RL: Extend rlqas.phase1.rl package with DQN support
integrationPoints.withAgentFactory: Update factory to support multiple agent types

code: examples/dqn_usage.py - Example script demonstrating DQN usage
documentation: API documentation for new classes and methods

unitTesting: Test DQNAgent interface compliance with RLAgent base class
Verify agent factory creates correct agent types
Test save/load functionality with round-trip validation
integrationTesting: Test DQN with UCCSearchEnv environment from Phase 1
Validate DQN learning on simple CartPole environment
Test agent switching via factory in multi-algorithm scenarios
Verify compatibility with Phase 1 validation pipeline
performanceValidation: Benchmark DQN training performance vs PPO baseline
Measure memory usage and computational efficiency
Validate learning stability across multiple random seeds

notes: This task focuses on DQN implementation only - multi-algorithm comparison framework is separate Task 002
DQN is particularly suited for discrete action spaces in quantum excitation operator selection
Replay buffer size should be tuned based on typical episode lengths in RLQAS
Epsilon decay schedule should account for sparse rewards in quantum architecture search
Consider adding prioritized experience replay in future enhancements
